goal: Create fizzbuzz.py. Running `python fizzbuzz.py N` prints the numbers 1..N one per line, with Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5 and FizzBuzz for multiples of both.
The tests in this project fail. Find the bugs in the code and fix them so `python -m unittest discover -q` passes. Don't change the tests.

Create todo.py with add(title) -> id, complete(id), pending() -> list of titles (in insertion order), all in memory, and test_todo.py with unittest tests covering them. `python -m unittest discover -q` must pass.

checks.cmd: python -c "import todo; a = todo.add('a'); todo.add('b'); todo.complete(a); assert todo.pending() == ['b'], todo.pending(); print('ok')"
